newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian GDP up 3.1 percent in first-half 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian GDP up 3.1 percent in first-half 1996.

text.p: The gross domestic product of the Baltic state of Lithuania grew by 3.1 percent in the first six months of the year compared with the same period last year, the statistics department said on Friday.
It said that GDP rose to 13.984 billion litas in the first six months of the year versus 10.071 billion litas in the first half of 1995.
Previous forecasts for total year growth for Lithuania have ranged between one and two percent after it was hit by a banking crisis at the start of the year.
